summary: Extends restoration of explicit nullability annotations onto captured wildcard types so that a captured extends-wildcard whose counterpart is a non-wildcard type gets the annotation on its backing wildcard's upper bound, fixing missed errors for direct and local-variable calls (the submitted diff also carries stacked #1666 changes to CheckIdenticalNullabilityVisitor and AddAnnotationToNestedTypeVisitor).

tests.evidence: Bug fix owes regression tests (present: testDirect/testWithSelf/testWithVar), but only positive-error cases; lazaroclapp asked for the safe case returning Nested<? extends @Nullable String>, which the final diff adds as testWithVarSafe.

user_docs.evidence: Internal checker precision fix; no option or documented behavior changes.

doc_comments.evidence: visitCapturedType Javadoc is extended to explain the new non-wildcard-counterpart case and matches the code; CodeRabbit's requests for test-method Javadoc are contradicted by the AGENTS.md rule the PR adds.

change_description.evidence: Description names the missed case and the new test; NullAway writes CHANGELOG at release, so no entry owed in the PR.

performance.evidence: Adds a clone of a captured type only when an annotation actually changes; not a hot path concern.

backward_compat.evidence: Users in JSpecify mode may see new 'incompatible types' errors on previously accepted code, which is the intended bug fix.

concurrency.evidence: Not touched; the copy in replaceCapturedTypeWildcard avoids mutating shared javac capture types, which is aliasing, not threading.

error_model.evidence: No new diagnostic kind or message; existing 'incompatible types' error reported in more places.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial type-visitor logic in TypeSubstitutionUtils.visitCapturedType (EXTENDS-bound branch, identity checks, cloning a shared CapturedType) plus the wildcard-flag branching in CheckIdenticalNullabilityVisitor; mandated careful review of the edge cases (super/unbounded wildcards, no-op updates).

user_value.evidence: Bug fix, no new feature or API.

surprising_behavior.evidence: New errors appear for code shapes (direct call vs self() chain) that previously behaved inconsistently; the change removes an inconsistency rather than adding one.

contradictions.evidence: The PR makes testDirect/testWithVar agree with testWithSelf; the library-model test and the JSpecify test mirror each other; nothing contradictory found.

build_ci.evidence: Test fixture additions in test-java-lib and test-library-models only.

spec_conformance.evidence: Interprets JSpecify nullness for captured wildcards and their upper bounds (Nested<? extends @Nullable T> vs Nested<? extends String>); whether the reported incompatibility matches JSpecify subtyping is the core question.

plan.why: A cohesive type-visitor fix with its tests; one reviewer versed in javac capture types and JSpecify covers all three.
